name: @kealthas-dev/opencode-llm-review-gate
description: llm-review-gate.ts opencode plugin (gates bash tool calls behind an LLM safety review before they run, via a real review_verdict function-call tool with a text-parsing fallback), published to npm so opencode's own npm-plugin loader can install it directly from a bare package name in opencode.json's plugin array - see CLAUDE.md. Written in TypeScript against @opencode-ai/plugin's Plugin type (type-only) plus a real `zod` runtime dependency for the tool's argument schema - the one plugin in this repo with an actual runtime dependency, unlike hook-logger.ts/system-prompt-tools.ts's zero-dependency design. Independently installable from hook-logger.ts - not bundled together.
